name: dnd-chronicle-vnext
description: A clean foundation for the next generation of D&D Chronicle.
author: D&D Chronicle

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && vite build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dist:win: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:win:publish: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish always
